name: scribd-cli
description: Interactive terminal app (TUI) that renders a Scribd embed document and saves a visually faithful PDF to disk.
author: Justin Parker <jparkerweb@gmail.com>

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const cp=require('child_process');const path=require('path');const cli=path.join(path.dirname(require.resolve('playwright/package.json')),'cli.js');cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,[cli,'install','chromium'],{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.warn('[scribd-cli] Could not auto-install Chromium. Run: npx playwright install chromium')}"
